calculations.original_public_message: Source q16 reports segregated cash and securities: 2010 cash $25.0B and securities fair value $9.7B. Adding these gives total assets segregated for 2010.
For 2009, cash segregated was $24.0B and securities fair value was $10.2B; combined segregated assets are $34.2B.

raw_final.calculation: For each year, total segregated assets = segregated cash + fair value of segregated securities. 2010: 25.0 + 9.7 = 34.7 billion. 2009: 24.0 + 10.2 = 34.2 billion.
